_about: Rates for equity cash-market trades. Percent values are percent of turnover (qty x price). Every block says where it came from and whether it has been matched to a real contract note. Nothing here is verified until a contract note test passes: run charges.py against one and set verified to the date.

statutory._source: Statutory, same at every broker. STT: Finance Act; stamp duty: Indian Stamp Act (2020 uniform rates); SEBI turnover fee: SEBI. Read 2026-10-27 from zerodha.com/charges via search results.

exchange_txn_pct._source: Exchange transaction charges as passed through by Zerodha. Zerodha's pages showed 0.00297, 0.00307 and 0.00322 for NSE across versions on 2026-10-27, so this is the value to confirm first from a contract note.

zerodha._source: zerodha.com/charges, read via search results 2026-10-27. DP charge from memory of the published rate (Rs 13 + GST per scrip per day): confirm on a contract note or DP statement.
